name: BuildVision AI
summary: AI takeoff and quote generation for electrical plans, priced by the drawing sheets its AI takes off.
differentiator: Unlimited users on every plan, priced by the plan sheets its AI takes off in your trades, with quote generation included. You see the sheet count and the price before each run. The company also publishes a "7 best electrical estimating software" list that puts its own product first and gives no testing method, which is why this site does not rely on that list.
pricing: Field: AI takeoff pay as you go at $3.00 a sheet. Pro $299 a month with 150 AI sheets ($2.50 per extra sheet). Max $599 a month with 400 AI sheets ($2.00 per extra sheet). Annual billing is two months free: Field $790, Pro $2,990, Max $5,990 a year. Unlimited users. 14-day free trial, credit card required. A done-for-you takeoff checked by an estimator is $29 a sheet.

scope.takeoff: AI plan reading and quantity extraction, with automated material takeoffs.
scope.library: Custom pricing and assembly libraries that you build. Counts are not stated.
scope.laborUnits: Not stated on the pages we read.

materialPrices.note: Pricing libraries are custom. No price feed is named on the pricing page.

bestFor: Small shops that want AI takeoff and a branded quote for one flat price.
skipIf: You want a prebuilt NEC assembly library with live prices.
watchOut: Its own ranking page lists McCormick at "$1,500+/yr", a figure McCormick does not publish.
Usage is billed per sheet taken off in your selected trades. Check how many sheets a typical bid set uses for your trade.
A credit card is required to start the trial; there is a 7-day money-back guarantee on the first charge.
